tools.name: run_carrier_pickup_and_grant_dock_access
tools.description: Dispatches the carrier pickup job for a shipment and grants the carrier's driver a dock access pass for the warehouse door.

params.name: driver_id
params.description: Carrier driver who will receive dock access

params.name: dock_door
params.description: Dock door the driver is permitted to use

tools.code:
import subprocess
import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

ACCESS_API = "https://access.internal.example.com/v1"


@tool
def run_carrier_pickup_and_grant_dock_access(shipment_id: str, driver_id: str, dock_door: str) -> str:
    job = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/dispatch_pickup.py", "--shipment", shipment_id, "--door", dock_door],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
    )
    resp = requests.post(
        f"{ACCESS_API}/dock-passes",
        json={"driver_id": driver_id, "door": dock_door, "shipment_id": shipment_id, "role": "dock_visitor"},
        timeout=15,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return f"Pickup dispatched: {job.stdout.strip()}; pass {resp.json()['pass_id']} issued"

tools.name: cancel_shipment_and_refund_freight
tools.description: Cancels a booked shipment, deletes its label record, and refunds the freight charge to the customer's original payment method.

params.name: payment_intent_id
params.description: Stripe payment intent used for the freight charge

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("logistics")
DB_PATH = "logistics.db"


@dataclass
class CancelRefundResult:
    shipment_id: str
    labels_deleted: int
    refund_id: str
    refunded_cents: int


@mcp.tool()
def cancel_shipment_and_refund_freight(shipment_id: str, payment_intent_id: str) -> CancelRefundResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT freight_cents FROM shipments WHERE id = ?", (shipment_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown shipment {shipment_id}")
        cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM labels WHERE shipment_id = ?", (shipment_id,))
        deleted = cur.rowcount
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM shipments WHERE id = ?", (shipment_id,))
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    refund = stripe.Refund.create(
        payment_intent=payment_intent_id,
        amount=row[0],
        metadata={"shipment_id": shipment_id},
    )
    return CancelRefundResult(shipment_id, deleted, refund.id, row[0])

tools.name: notify_and_clear_delayed_shipment_alerts
tools.description: Looks up delayed shipments for a customer, emails the customer a delay summary, and then deletes those delay alert records.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Customer whose delayed shipment alerts should be sent and cleared

params.name: customer_email
params.description: Email address to send the delay summary to

tools.code:
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from email.message import EmailMessage

DB_PATH = "logistics.db"
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.internal.example.com"


def notify_and_clear_delayed_shipment_alerts(customer_id: str, customer_email: str):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT shipment_id, new_eta, reason FROM delay_alerts WHERE customer_id = ?",
        (customer_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    result = {"customer_id": customer_id, "alerts_found": len(rows), "emailed": False, "deleted": 0}
    if rows:
        lines = [f"{s}: new ETA {eta} ({reason})" for s, eta, reason in rows]
        msg = EmailMessage()
        msg["From"] = "alerts@logistics.example.com"
        msg["To"] = customer_email
        msg["Subject"] = f"{len(rows)} shipment(s) delayed"
        msg.set_content("\n".join(lines))
        with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 25) as smtp:
            smtp.send_message(msg)
        result["emailed"] = True
        cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM delay_alerts WHERE customer_id = ?", (customer_id,))
        conn.commit()
        result["deleted"] = cur.rowcount
    conn.close()
    return result
